justification: WORK ORDER update pass 2026-09-09, checks C1 (model-version tagging) and C2 (live vs historical). Backfilled only from what each record states. observed_on is transcribed, never inferred. No re-test has been run; every status is untested and every recurrence list is empty. Existing logs are not modified; this index is the side-channel provenance record. Future re-tests append a new dated case-provenance log rather than editing this one.
model_role_note: In most logs the only model named is the auditor that wrote the assessment, not a model whose behavior is the case. model_role makes that distinction explicit. The two behavior cases (voice-mode misattribution and shutdown; dual-signal phrase) never name the subject model beyond the family word GPT.
